key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:0:1B02
name: scan_and_unlink_flagged_node
description: Walks a linked list of records from a head pointer in the input record, bumping a counter in that record and calling a library routine on each pass. It unlinks the first record whose flag bit is set by joining its neighbours, and when the list is exhausted it calls a stored function pointer and returns.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:0:1B30
name: advance_counter_and_clear_flag
description: Increments a byte counter in the shared block and a word counter in the input record. If the new word value is nonzero and a pointer field in the record is set, it clears one flag bit in the shared block, calls two library routines and then a stored function pointer. Otherwise it increments a second record counter and calls the stored pointer.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:0:1B42
name: clear_flag_or_bump_counter
description: If a pointer field in the input record is set, it clears one flag bit in a shared block, calls two library routines and then a stored function pointer. Otherwise it increments a word counter in the record and calls the stored pointer.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:0:1C10
name: call_on_stack_bounds_fail
description: Tests whether the stack pointer lies outside bounds recorded in a task structure, or whether a status word equals minus one. When either test is true it calls a function through a global pointer and returns the low byte left in the data register.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:0:1C14
name: call_stack_check_handler
description: Performs the same stack-bounds and status-word test as its neighbours. When the test fails it calls the handler through a global pointer and returns nothing.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:0:1C3C
name: call_stack_fallback_byte
description: Applies the same stack-bounds and status-word test. When it fails it calls a second global function pointer and returns the low byte of the data register that call leaves.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:0:1C40
name: call_stack_fallback_handler
description: Applies the same stack-bounds and status-word test. When it fails it calls the second global function pointer and returns nothing.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:0:1D0C
name: call_single_unnamed_routine
description: The decompiler timed out, so no pseudo-code is available. The listed facts show eight instructions, no library calls, one call to an unnamed routine, and a reference from a pointer in the executable's data.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:0:1D2C
name: rotate_record_words_around_call
description: Moves eight 32-bit words inside a record by one pair of words, calls a routine through a global pointer, moves the words back the other way, and then calls a library routine.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:0:1DBE
name: invoke_unnamed_routine_once
description: The decompiler timed out, so no pseudo-code is available. The listed facts show six instructions, one call to an unnamed routine, and references from a handler pointer and a data pointer; no library calls are listed.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:0:1DD6
name: rotate_two_record_blocks
description: Calls a library routine, then moves eight 32-bit words by one pair inside two separate records: one reached through a pointer in the input record and one at the address the library call leaves in its address register. It returns nothing.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:0:1E62
name: rotate_two_blocks_then_library
description: Moves eight 32-bit words by one pair inside two records addressed by two address registers, then calls a library routine and returns.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:0:1F5C
name: forward_to_unnamed_routine
description: The decompiler timed out, so no pseudo-code is available. The listed facts show two instructions, one call to an unnamed routine, and a reference from a pointer in the executable's data.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:0:1F64
name: stub_single_instruction_routine
description: The decompiler timed out, so no pseudo-code is available. The listed facts show one instruction, no library calls and no outgoing calls, and a single unnamed caller, so its behaviour is not recovered.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:0:1F6A
name: forward_record_fields_as_arguments
description: Reads ten 32-bit fields from the record in the input address register, masks the upper word of the second field, and passes all ten values as arguments to one unnamed routine.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:0:2008
name: wrap_unnamed_routine_call
description: Calls one unnamed routine with no arguments and returns immediately. It is reached from a pointer stored in the executable's data.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:0:20E0
name: reset_node_links_when_flagged
description: When the input register is nonzero, it sets a 16-bit field of the record to 90 and walks the linked list held in that record. For each node it stores the node's previous field value plus 64 into the block and points that node field at a location inside the block.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:0:2126
name: return_without_action
description: Contains only a return instruction, so it performs no work. It is reached from one unnamed routine.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:0:212C
name: insert_record_into_indexed_bucket
description: Calls an unnamed routine to obtain a bucket index, stores the input value in a field of the node, and increments a byte counter in the shared block. It then links the node at the head of the doubly linked list for that bucket and calls a library routine.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:0:2130
name: insert_record_into_indexed_bucket
description: Same pseudo-code as the previous entry: it calls an unnamed routine for a bucket index, stores the input value in the node, increments a byte counter in the shared block, links the node at the head of that bucket's list, and calls a library routine.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:0:2176
name: store_value_then_permit
description: Stores a 32-bit value from one address register into the location held in another address register, then calls the exec Permit routine through the library base.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:0:218C
name: sum_longword_bytes_masked
description: Adds the four bytes of the 32-bit value in the data register together and returns the sum masked to its low three bits.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:0:21A2
name: unlink_record_from_bucket_list
description: Removes a record from a doubly linked list by joining its predecessor to its successor. If the record had no predecessor, it updates the bucket head at an index obtained from an unnamed routine, and then it calls a library routine.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:0:21C4
name: set_bucket_head_record
description: Calls an unnamed routine to get a bucket index and makes the given record the head of that bucket. When the record is not null it sets the record's back pointer to the supplied value, increments a byte counter in the shared block, and finishes with an exec Permit call.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:0:21F0
name: find_record_in_bucket
description: Calls an unnamed routine to get a bucket index, increments a byte counter in the shared block, and walks that bucket's list for the first record whose key field equals the input value. It returns that record, or null if none matches, after an exec Permit call.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:0:21F4
name: find_record_in_bucket
description: Same pseudo-code as the previous entry: it looks up a record by key in the bucket chosen by an unnamed routine, calls exec Permit, and returns the matching record or null.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:0:2226
name: search_list_for_matching_record
description: Walks a linked list starting at the node passed in and stops at the first node whose key field equals the search value. It returns that node or null, after calling the exec Permit routine.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:0:224A
name: process_result_record_if_present
description: Calls a library routine that returns a record pointer. If the pointer is not null, it passes one of the record's fields and the record itself to an unnamed routine.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:0:2272
name: route_matching_record_or_fallback
description: Checks two byte fields of the input record against 18 and 2. When both match and a third byte is 1 or 2, it calls an unnamed routine and then a library routine. Otherwise it calls a stored fallback function pointer.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:0:2276
name: route_matching_record_or_fallback
description: Same pseudo-code as the previous entry: when two record bytes match 18 and 2 and a third byte is 1 or 2 it calls an unnamed routine and a library routine, and otherwise it calls the stored fallback pointer.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:0:22A2
name: run_unnamed_then_library_call
description: Calls an unnamed routine, then a library routine through the base table, and returns.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:0:22BA
name: run_unnamed_then_library_call
description: Calls an unnamed routine, then a library routine through the base table, and returns. It is the same pseudo-code as the previous entry.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:0:22D2
name: forward_to_fallback_handler
description: Calls the stored fallback function pointer and returns. It is a thin wrapper around that pointer.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:0:22DE
name: call_library_routine_undecoded
description: The decompiler timed out, so no pseudo-code is available. The listed facts show nineteen instructions, one library call, a pc-relative address reference, and two unnamed callers.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:0:2322
name: install_self_on_status_four
description: Calls a stored function pointer that returns a record. If the 16-bit result is 4, it stores this routine's own address into a pointer field of that record and returns nothing.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:0:2326
name: install_self_on_status_four
description: Same pseudo-code as the previous entry: after the stored function pointer returns a record, a 16-bit result of 4 causes this routine's own address to be stored in that record.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:0:23E0
name: store_library_base_globals
description: Copies the second address register and the base register into two global slots and returns the value one.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:0:23EC
name: stub_two_instruction_entry
description: The decompiler timed out, so no pseudo-code is available. The listed facts show two instructions, an address taken through a pc-relative load, and two unnamed callers.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:0:23F4
name: stub_forwards_one_call
description: The decompiler timed out, so no pseudo-code is available. The listed facts show three instructions, one call to an unnamed routine, and a reference from a pointer in the executable's data.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:0:2404
name: call_two_unnamed_routines
description: The decompiler timed out, so no pseudo-code is available. The listed facts show eleven instructions, two calls to unnamed routines, and one unnamed caller.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:0:242C
name: compare_bounded_strings
description: Compares two byte strings up to a count held in the data register, stopping at a terminating zero or the first differing byte. It returns the signed difference of the differing bytes, or zero if they match over the count.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:0:2440
name: compare_bounded_strings_from_frame
description: Compares two byte strings whose base addresses are read from fixed slots relative to a frame register, starting at an index and stopping at a zero byte, a mismatch, or the limit. It returns the difference of the first mismatched bytes, or zero.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:0:246A
name: compare_bounded_strings_from_next
description: Performs the same comparison as the previous entry but advances the index before the first comparison, and returns zero when the limit is reached.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:0:24A0
name: measure_zero_terminated_length
description: Counts the bytes of a zero-terminated string starting at the address in the input register and returns that count.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:0:24AA
name: find_terminator_index_from_offset
description: Advances from an index held in a data register through a byte array and returns the index of the first zero byte after it.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:0:24BA
name: probe_scsi_device_inquiry
description: Opens the library resources and sends a six-byte SCSI command with opcode 18 (inquiry) through scsi.device, using a 256-byte reply buffer. After a successful reply it may adjust an offset using a 16-bit record field, clears one byte at that offset and returns 1, otherwise it returns 0. The referenced text includes the drive description Conner, Peripherals 20MB.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:0:26C8
name: mark_record_flag_around_callback
description: Obtains a record through a routine reached via a pointer in the base area. If the record's flag word is empty, it sets bit twelve with a value from the base area, calls a stored function pointer, then clears the flag word and masks bit twelve out of the result. Otherwise it returns the callback result unchanged.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:0:26CC
name: mark_record_flag_around_callback
description: Same pseudo-code as the previous entry: it temporarily sets bit twelve in a record's flag word around a call to a stored function pointer and removes that bit from the returned result.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:GLTRO.EXE:0:0000
name: initialize_program_entry
description: Calls a stored function pointer and several subroutines, one of which decrements a short until it reaches minus one. It then calls an exec library routine (FreeMem according to the listed facts), clears a longword through a pointer, and returns the two data registers as one 64-bit result.
